GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bumped & unbalanced @ start. Niggled early & raced behnd Mid Field on inside (5L from lead). Held Ground until pushed to quicken Two Wide @ 500m. ushed along Four Wide (4L from lead) on home turn. Weakened Six Wide in straight. # Ordinary effort.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped and unbalanced shortly after the start.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down well back 8 lengths. well back turn 8 lengths. ran on strongly along fence # too far back

Jumped Ok well back Settled Down last 5 Lengths 1000m 3 Wide 6th 6 Lengths 600m 3 Wide Hard Ridden 3rd 3 Lengths Straightened Up Under Pressure 3rd last Middle Of Track only held ground Straight # bac/wide/no run on
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 2 Lengths Settled Down 2nd last 8 Lengths 800m last 8 Lengths home turn Hard Ridden last 10 Lengths rails run Straight to make ground # last/ran on/further

Jumped okay & Settled Down 2.5 Lengths 3 Wide , held together much same to turn 2 Lengths 3 Wide , hit Lead Straightening Up before beinh Headed at 200m, lost a little ground to the line # battled on fairly
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Lost the off-hind plate in the running.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay, Eased & Settled Down 6 Lengths 2-3 wide, shifted 3 Wide at 700m, Drifted Back to 8 Lengths 3 Wide turning, tightened 300m and Lost Ground in Straight # mostly Wide
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide throughout. Approaching the 300m, eased when tightened for room.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay, taken straight across and Settled Down last 8 Lengths 2-3 wide, made no ground to 8 Lengths rail turning, Made Some Ground along fence in straight. (Blinkers OFF AGAIN, Winkers FIRST TIME) # never a threat
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: From the wide gate was allowed to shift across and obtain cover at the back of the field.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fast Restrained Took sit Settled Down 3rd Inside 2 Lengths Hard Ridden x 600 Couldn'T Go On Soon After Straightening Up - # Prefer To See Again
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Laid out under pressure in the home straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Went Forward to 1.5 Lengths joint Lead on fence, Held Together in front & led by a head turning, Headed 150m and weakened a little from there to line. (Blinkers AGAIN) # battled on fairly
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped on jumping. Bumped near the 1400m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 6.5 Lengths 3 Wide , worked forward from the 650m to 4 Lengths 3 Wide turning, laid in rounding home turn then moved into 4th place in Straight without making up any ground on the placegetters. [Stewards: Raced keenly early stages.] # Wide throughout
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keen early. Laid in under pressure round home turn resulting in rider having to stop and straighten, a short distance later laid in and bumped. Cast the off-fore plate in running.
